metadata.name: GetStatementMetadata
metadata.description: This API will provide Meta Data (field values) to generate PDF statement for each account.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of cardholder Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: 8000000000000037 Condition:At least one of Card Number\Admin Number\Account Number\ Account id is required, when Statement ID is not provided. *If Statement ID is provided then this parameter will be ignored. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Card Number of account holder Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: 1236547896541236 Condition: At least one of Card Number\Admin Number\Account Number\ Account id is required, when Statement ID is not provided. *If Statement ID is provided then this parameter will be ignored. Allowable Values: 16

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid). Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXX Example: 12345 Condition: At least one of Card Number\Admin Number\Account Number\ Account id is required, when Statement ID is not provided. *If Statement ID is provided then this parameter will be ignored.

request_fields.name: AccountID
request_fields.description: Account ID represents Unique Identity of Account (CoreCard Bsegment Entitity, i.e., the Account ID of program card account). Format: XXXXX Example: 12345 Condition: At least one of Card Number\Admin Number\Account Number\ Account id is required, when Statement ID is not provided. *If Statement ID is provided then this parameter will be ignored.

request_fields.name: StatementDate
request_fields.description: Date when Statement is generated. Format: MM/dd/yyyy Example: 12/21/22019 Condition: Statement Date is mandatory when Statement ID is not provided. *If Statement ID is provided then this parameter will be ignored.

request_fields.name: StatementID
request_fields.description: Unique Identifier for generated Statement Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XX Condition: Statement Id is optional only when Any one from Card Number, Admin Number, Account Number,  Account Id and Statement Date is provided.

request_fields.name: ApplicantType
request_fields.description: Selects the type of Applicants. Valid Values: 1, 2, 3 Format: x Example:  1= "Applicant", 2 ="Co-Applicant", 3= "Cosigner", Allowable Values: 20

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: FileName
children.description: Contains URL of the statement handler Valid Value: 0-9, A-Z Example: For ApiVersion: 3.0 FilePath = https://statementhandler.corecard.com/WebStatementHandler.ashx?StatementKey=(Key value) Contains File Path of the statement or URL of the statement handler based on the product setup Valid Values: 0-9 A-Z Example: ApiVersion: 2.0 FileName = ?Path=(Statement file location) Allowable Values: 100
